overview: This House resolution formally expresses the House of Representatives' deep sorrow at the death of David Scott, who represented Georgia in the House. It directs the Clerk of the House to send the resolution to the Senate and a copy to Representative Scott's family. It also provides that the House adjourn for the day as a further mark of respect. Resolutions like this are a long-standing House tradition when a sitting or former member dies. The House agreed to it on April 22, 2026.
for: Supporters say it is a customary and fitting way for the House to honor a colleague's service and offer condolences to his family.
against: Critics say the resolution is ceremonial and doesn't change any law or spending.
